name: DIRE (ICCV 2023) diffusion reconstruction error
reason: DIRE is not a drop-in checkpoint: it requires a pretrained ADM diffusion model plus a per-image inversion/reconstruction pipeline, and the repo ships training/eval code rather than a single detector weight file. Not wired; kept as a documented placeholder profile.
fetch: Source and instructions: https://github.com/ZhendongWang6/DIRE — wiring it would need an ADM checkpoint (OpenAI guided-diffusion weights) plus a DIRE reconstruction runner; contributions welcome behind optional deps.
limitations: This profile never produces scores; it exists to document the candidate and its fetch path.
Even when wired, diffusion-reconstruction error is a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
